provenance.license: Natural Earth — public domain; no permission required to use, attribution appreciated but not required (naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use)
provenance.projection: equirectangular-lat-corrected — custom cylindrical (x=lon*cos(std_parallel), y=lat), standard parallel tuned near the horizon's mid-latitude; see the 'projection' block above for this build's actual values
provenance.simplification: shapely Douglas-Peucker (preserve_topology=True): iterative tolerance search to a 30-150pt reference budget for ref_path, and a 12-40pt (30-70pt for coastal-identity regions: anatolia/egypt-nile/horn/arabia) silhouette budget for path, followed by 3 rounds of Chaikin corner-cutting
provenance.certainty: per-region, see each entry's cultural_extent field ('official' | 'approximate')
provenance.manual_edits: none — every region's geometry is a shapely union of whole Natural Earth admin0/admin1 units named in region_composition.json; zero hand-drawn or hand-nudged coordinates anywhere in this file
